name: kxco-pq-cli
description: Post-quantum key management from a terminal: recoverable ML-DSA-65 keys, signed key rotation with an optional on-chain anchor, and file signing and verification, offline by default and with no code to write.
author: Shayne Heffernan and John Heffernan

scripts.test: node --test test/jcs.test.js test/manifest.test.js test/keygen.test.js test/fingerprint.test.js test/rotate.test.js test/attest.test.js test/property.test.js test/ml-dsa-87.test.js
scripts.lint: node -c bin/kxco-pq.js && node -c src/cli.js && node -c src/jcs.js && node -c src/manifest.js && node -c src/commands/keygen.js && node -c src/commands/fingerprint.js && node -c src/commands/rotate.js
